evidence: Codex 0.147.0 stable App Server schema describes command/exec as standalone sandboxed argv execution without creating a thread or turn.
P0/P1 observed no thread/* or turn/* notifications during buffered command/exec acceptance.
P2 command/exec works inside an ephemeral CODEX_HOME with no mounted Codex login credential and Docker network=none.

process/spawn.reason: Internal-only host process substrate for launching the pinned official Computer Use helper. Never expose generic process/spawn to remote callers.

process/writeStdin.reason: Internal-only stdin transport to the already validated official Computer Use helper process.

process/kill.reason: Internal-only cleanup for the official Computer Use helper process.

denyFamilies.reason: Not required by the thin model-free bridge. Some thread methods enter model/session behavior; thread/shellCommand is explicitly documented by Codex 0.147.0 as unsandboxed with full access.
Turn methods are outside the model-free toolbox boundary and may consume Codex model/service quota.
Review is outside the model-free toolbox boundary and may start model-backed work.

account/usage/read.reason: May be used by upgrade acceptance to compare account usage before/after a candidate method; not part of the remote toolbox.

account/rateLimits/read.reason: May be used by upgrade acceptance to inspect account/rate-limit state; not part of the remote toolbox.

knownButUnclassified.command/exec/write: deny until persistent-process semantics and cost/safety behavior are separately accepted
knownButUnclassified.command/exec/terminate: deny until persistent-process semantics are separately accepted
knownButUnclassified.command/exec/resize: deny until persistent-process semantics are separately accepted
